fishing.bait_desc: Choose your bait. Each tier attracts different fish!
fishing.bite_missed_desc: You hesitated too long — the fish took your bait and escaped.
fishing.bottle_found: You pull a weathered bottle from the water. Inside, a message awaits...
fishing.bottle_hint_ghost: The ink glows faintly: *"When the moon is high and the pond is still, a pale spirit rises from the deep..."* , thus is the fabled Ghost Carp said to appear.
fishing.bottle_hint_kraken: Scrawled in ragged script: *"Beyond the waves, a leviathan sleeps. Throw a golden lure into the abyss if you dare wake it."*
fishing.bottle_letter_elara: A note in elegant handwriting: *"Dear fisher, if you catch a Star Fruit, I will reward you generously. , Elara"*
fishing.bottle_letter_irian: A sealed letter from Irian to a fellow fisher: *"The fish grow strange near Lava Pool. Bring me a Magma Carp and I'll tell you what I know."*
fishing.bottle_lore: The parchment bears the mark of an ancient mariner. It tells of a forgotten harbor where *"the fish wear crowns of gold"* , gold. A clue, perhaps, for those who seek the rare and golden.
fishing.cooldown: ⏳ You need to wait {time}s before fishing again.
fishing.empty_desc_lost: You reel in an empty line. The bait is gone forever.
fishing.empty_desc_refund: You reel in an empty line. Luck was on your side — the bait survived.
fishing.error: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again.
fishing.escaped_desc:
Your line snapped! At least you gained some experience.
✨ Fisher XP: +{xp}
fishing.expired_desc: The fish took your bait and swam away... Next time!
fishing.flavor_cosmic_jellyfish: 🌌 The water shimmers with an alien light. What you've hooked is not of this world.
fishing.flavor_day: ☀️ The midday sun glints off the gentle ripples.
fishing.flavor_dusk: 🌅 Golden hour paints the water in shades of amber and rose.
fishing.flavor_ghost_carp: 👻 A translucent shape drifts beneath the surface. It glows faintly...
fishing.flavor_golden: ✨ The sunlight catches golden scales beneath the surface...
fishing.flavor_high_1: 🌋 The water erupts! A primordial beast awakens!
fishing.flavor_high_2: ⚡ A thunderous pull nearly yanks the rod from your hands!
fishing.flavor_high_3: 🐉 The surface explodes , something colossal is fighting back!
fishing.flavor_low_1: 🎣 A moderate shadow circles your bait...
fishing.flavor_low_2: 🐟 Something's tugging steadily at your line!
fishing.flavor_low_3: 🌿 The line quivers , a decent catch is on!
fishing.flavor_mid_1: 🌊 A powerful force tugs your line deep below!
fishing.flavor_mid_2: 💪 This one means business , it's pulling hard!
fishing.flavor_mid_3: 🔥 You feel the heat of a fierce battle incoming!
fishing.flavor_mutated: 🌀 The water glows with an eerie bioluminescence... something is wrong.
fishing.flavor_night: 🌙 Under the pale moonlight, the water glimmers mysteriously.
fishing.flavor_trash_1: 🪱 A tiny nibble... something small took the bait.
fishing.flavor_trash_2: ♻️ You feel a light tug. Probably not a monster.
fishing.flavor_trash_3: 💧 Barely a ripple. This one's an easy catch.
fishing.free_used: ❌ Free casts used. Worm required from inventory.
fishing.lava_field_value: Extreme! Molten depths with legendary beasts.
fishing.legendary_bait_desc: Glows with power. Draws the deadliest monsters.
fishing.limit_reached: 🎣 You've fished enough today! Come back tomorrow.
fishing.lore_found: You discovered a new lore fragment! Check `/lore` to read it.
fishing.lucky_break_active: 💫 Your line barely held! One wrong move and it's over.
fishing.milestone_decent: 🗣️ *"That's a decent catch!"* , fellow fisher nods approvingly.
fishing.milestone_epic: 📜 *"They'll write songs about this catch."*. The old fisherman tips his hat.
fishing.milestone_huge: 📸 *"Hold it up! I gotta get a picture!"* , someone pulls out their phone.
fishing.milestone_large: 👀 *"Whoa, that's a big one!"* , nearby fishermen gather to look.
fishing.milestone_legendary: 🏆 *"The biggest catch of the year!"*. The dock erupts in cheers!
fishing.mood_diving: 🌊 The fish dives deep, pulling against the current!
fishing.mood_thrashing: 💦 The fish thrashes at the surface!
fishing.mood_tiring: 😮‍💨 The fish is tiring... now's your chance!
fishing.no_bait: ❌ You don't have this bait in your inventory!
fishing.quiet_desc:
🐟 An easy catch! You reel in a **{name}** ({weight}lb, {size}in)
✨ Fisher XP: +{xp}
fishing.spooked_desc: You struck too early! The fish got spooked and swam away.
fishing.wait_desc:
Line cast... the water is calm.
Be patient and wait for a bite.
